Description
Hello there! Welcome to my Sheepsquatch SNPC addon!

This addon contains recreation of Sheepsquatch from Fallout 76

NPC:

Fallout 76:

Sheepsquatch

Features:
Original + custom animations
Spawn animation
Sheepsquatch is neutral by default and will only attack players/NPC that are too close(but it will try to close the distance so beware)
Multiple attacks depending on the combat situation(enemy in front, enemy behind, mobbed by enemies, enemy far)
Stomp attack that deals heavy damage to everything on the ground(and also too close)
Quill throw attack
Quill burst attack
Lunge attack
Heavy horn attacks
Back kick attack(if enemy behind)
Quills can ran out(after using any quill attack or on explosion)
Quills can regrow
Quills deal poison damage over time
Dodging
Horns can be torn off by shooting them or blowing Sheepsquatch up(makes horn attacks weak/unavailable)
2 phases
Red glow effect on second phase
On second phase sheepsquatch gets more attack animations, larger damage and faster quill regrowing
Hair can be burned(cosmetic only)
Direction, damage and hitgroup based flinch animations
Direction based death animation(+ extra death animation when Sheepsquatch is running)
Category icon
Russian and English text localisation
And more...

Enjoy!

Map in screenshots/video: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2550321794

Credits:
Bethesda Game Studios - All original assets.
Alien31 - Model port
Miss Misery - Addon commission
Arrowhead - Helldivers 2 sounds
4A Games - Metro sounds
Limakenori - coding, animating, texture/model/sound edits
